name: Myconid
traits:
Distress Spores. When myconid takes damage, all other myconids within 240 ft. can sense its pain.

Rapport Spores (3/day). 30-ft. radius. Creatures with Int 2+ gain telepathy with each other for 1 hour.

Not evil — start hostile but can be parleyed (DC 20 Charisma).
actions:
Fist. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.

Pacifying Spores (3/day). 5-ft. radius. DC 11 Con save or stunned for 1 minute (repeat save).
notes:
Seagrow Caves — fungus farm (B2) has sprouts + violet fungi disguised among mushrooms.

Mention Tarak or his offering → advantage on Charisma checks.
